name: Anatolian Neolithic
alt: Anatolian Late Neolithic and Early Chalcolithic

ledger.x: 6000 BCE: the great Neolithic town of Catalhoyuk and the village of Hacilar hold the Anatolian plateau.
5600 BCE: the Early Chalcolithic begins; Catalhoyuk East is abandoned and the West Mound settled.
5000 BCE: the Anatolian Neolithic sequence on the map ends with Hacilar I.

certainty.note: Two radii around excavated sites stand for a culture whose extent the pages do not describe.
